verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Fieldwork marketing line that AI agents collect and package evidence 'on your schedule,' implying some recurring automation exists, but there is no documentation of how to configure, view, or manage recurring jobs/workflows, nor any API/MCP support for scheduling. Missing for 10: documented scheduling UI or API, cron-like configuration options, ability to trigger/monitor recurring jobs via MCP or service keys, and any independent confirmation this works as described.
